text.title: FreshDrop express slots, 2 districts of Moscow, 1 September 2026
text.hypothesis: buyers in 2 districts get a fixed slot from the app; we test value and the price of the slot
text.packaging: the 149 rub slot price and the reminder; no TV or outdoor ads
text.audience: Moscow districts Basmanny and Tverskoy; buyers with 2+ orders a month
text.criteria: repeat order within 14 days 35%+, conversion 5%+, margin 80 rub per order
text.numbers: repeat orders 38%, conversion 5.6%, margin 92 rub: all above threshold
text.feedback: «The reminder is what made me order again»; 6 of 10 interviews repeat the same praise
text.decision: scale to 6 districts if the margin holds for 4 weeks; otherwise shut down and move buyers to the standard slots
